message:
The other day, we were chatting about our family emergency plans, and I could see the eye rolls from the kids. It’s like they thought we were planning a trip to Mars instead of just being ready for a rainy day! 

But then, I pulled out our go-bags, and suddenly, their curiosity was piqued. They wanted to know what snacks we packed and why we needed extra socks. It turned into a fun little family project, turning ‘boring prep’ into a treasure hunt of sorts. 

Now, every time we check our supplies, the kids get involved and even ask if they can add their favorite snacks! Who knew preparedness could be a bonding experience? What little adventures do you all have when it comes to getting ready together? 😊
